description: Police Precincts: NYPD source precinct polygons clipped to land
status_summary: Area within 0.01% of prod for 77 of 78 precincts; precinct 113 (0.02%) is prod-side: prod clipped it to a different Jamaica Bay / JFK shoreline than prod's own nybb. 13 SHAPE_Length diffs: prod slivers (9) and shoreline slits (4)
notes: Not built from the AtomicPolygon topology: NYPD's precinct and beat lines don't follow AP edges (they cut through hundreds of APs), so no AP-level assignment reproduces them. Land is the union of the topology-built borough boundaries (int__boundary__bb), so the shoreline matches every other layer; parts and holes under 100 sq ft are dropped (hairline slivers where a precinct line runs almost along the shoreline). Prod's own layer carries many more small parts (462 vs our 182), so part counts and SHAPE_Length may still differ. Precinct 113: all 43,419 sq ft only we have lies inside prod's own nybb (Queens), and only 7 of the 31,844 sq ft only prod has does; the pieces follow AP water_flag 2 (ours) vs 1 (prod) along the shore, so prod's precinct clip used an older or different shoreline than its borough layer. The gdb file comparison flags 13 precincts, all on SHAPE_Length (area is within 0.003% for every one): in 9 (61, 17, 50, 19, 43, 72, 63, 23, 113) ours is shorter by the perimeter of prod's parts under 100 sq ft, which we drop; in 4 (41, 88, 110, 120) ours is longer because it follows hairline shoreline slits that prod's own nybb has (our shoreline is 0 ft from prod's there) but prod's precinct clip cuts across.
